ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Financial Transactions Reporting Act (Cap. 315) and the related AML/CFT Regulations; International Companies Act (Cap. 222) as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2021; VFSC rules on licensed registered agents and UBO filing; administered by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the UBO's and director's passport (biographical page)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the document's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming no adverse banking history and source of funds / wealth

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the Vanuatu FIU national sanctions list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and EU/UK HMT consolidated lists. Enhanced due diligence and PEP classification require escalation to the VFSC-licensed registered agent and the Vanuatu FIU. Source of funds and source of wealth documentation is required where beneficial ownership exceeds 25% or where any PEP indicator appears.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry — Online Name Search and Reservation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Latin script using English, Bislama, or French spellings; the name must end with 'International Company' or 'IC' (or an acceptable Latin abbreviation). Transliteration of foreign names into the Latin alphabet is required; all translations must be certified by a sworn translator.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended once for a further 30 days by filing a formal extension application with the VFSC before the initial reservation window expires. If a name is rejected, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of the rejection decision; the Registrar must issue a determination within 21 days. If the appeal is denied, a fresh name reservation application may be filed under a new name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a Vanuatu International Company. The IC must maintain a statutory registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu, but may be managed and controlled from abroad; no physical local premises are required for a non-resident, asset-light, tax-exempt IC used for the offshore licensing and sale of ICU mechanical ventilators. If local manufacturing or a physical retail presence in Vanuatu is established, a separate physical workplace and Business License will be required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 10% for the registered office of a compliant offshore IC; 60-75% for any separately licensed physical manufacturing facility in Vanuatu, given the medical-device product classification and the Vanuatu Ministry of Health's routine inspection powers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 1 of 1993 (Cap. 222), ss. 5-12, ss. 18-19 and ss. 102-115; International Companies Regulations 1993; International Companies (Fees) Regulations; Companies Act 2009 as general law where not inconsistent
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (VFSC Form IC-1A), together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered agent consent and statutory declarations
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; at least one issued share is required. Capital may be denominated in any currency and no escrow account or deposit capital rule applies to a Vanuatu International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscription of the founding shareholder for 100 ordinary shares of no-par value is ratified and share certificate No. 1 is issued. (2) The registered office located at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, is adopted, and the registered agent is authorized to file this office with VFSC. (3) [Director Name] is appointed Chief Executive Officer and [Secretary Name] is appointed Company Secretary, with each authorized severally to execute banking documentation and all statutory filings. (4) The officers are directed to procure all industrial, environmental and operational permits required for the medical device manufacturing business. This resolution takes effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Constitutional Document Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry, Port Vila via VFSC e-Registry portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed name reservation application for the proposed International Company, ensuring the name ends with an approved suffix such as Limited, Corp or Inc. Provide the draft Memorandum and Articles of Association to the licensed registered agent for pre-filing review. Pay the name reservation fee and receive the VFSC name clearance certificate before filing the full incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Proposed company name in English
Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Identity and due diligence documents of proposed shareholder and director
Proof of registered agent instruction
Name reservation fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, file a written objection or amended name request within 14 days; VFSC will reconsider without a second fee if the prior refusal was based on prohibited names. For due diligence queries, submit notarized bank references and verified copies of identity documents within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1A together with executed constitutional documents, declaration of compliance, consent of registered agent, registered office consent and the VFSC fee schedule remittance. Ensure all signatures are witnessed and notarized as required. The registered agent will physically or electronically lodge the packet.
required_dossiers: VFSC Form IC-1A (duly completed)
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Declaration of compliance by a director or applicant attorney
Consent to act as registered agent by a licensed VFSC agent
Registered office address confirmation in Port Vila
Power of attorney if filing through agent
Prescribed incorporation fee payment evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for formal defects, submit a rectification notice and corrected documents within 21 days. VFSC will not restart the processing period where the defect is purely technical. For substantive objections, submit supporting affidavits and additional due diligence evidence for re-assessment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation Issuance and Statutory Register Creation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, pay the certificate issuance fee and collect the certified Certificate of Incorporation and registered constitutional documents. Immediately prepare the company's statutory registers, including the register of shareholders, register of directors, register of charges and share ledger, and preserve these at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Registered Memorandum and Articles of Association bearing VFSC seal
Register of shareholders and share transfer register
Register of directors and secretaries
Register of charges (if any)
Consent to act of each director
Certificate of incorporation fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a typographical or legal name error, file a certified rectification request with VFSC supported by the issued certificate and board approval; VFSC will issue an amended certificate within 5 business days. If registration is delayed beyond SLA, the agent may escalate to the VFSC Registrar by written notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions, Officer Appointment and Registered Office Adoption
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors and Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting and adopt the pro-forma resolution to ratify share allotment, adopt the registered office and appoint officers. File the director and officer particulars, including signed consents, with VFSC within 30 days of incorporation. Ensure the registered agent agreement and registered office certificate are retained and the company seal, if used, is approved by board resolution.
required_dossiers: Minutes of first board meeting with signed resolutions
Subscription agreements and share application forms
Registered office service agreement with VFSC-licensed agent
Notices of director and officer appointments
Signed consents of directors and officers
Company seal adoption resolution and specimen certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC requires additional particulars, file a Form IC-4 amendment within 7 business days. If officer consents are defective, obtain new consents and submit a curative resolution; no penalty applies where the s. 19 registered agent filing occurred on time.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) together with the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce and the Vanuatu Medicines and Medical Devices Regulatory Unit operating under the Ministry of Health
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Manufacturing Establishment Licence and Industrial Plant Operation Permit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report required under the Environment Act No. 12 of 2002 for proposed manufacturing plant with Category 1 industrial activity, including cleanroom production, waste generation and point-source emissions
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Vanuatu Ambient Water Quality Standards and National Waste Management Guidelines; wastewater pH 6.0-9.0, BOD not exceeding 30 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L and residual chlorine not exceeding 0.1 mg/L; stack VOC emissions controlled to not more than 50 mg/Nm3; refrigerant and ozone-depleting substances handled under the Ozone Depleting Substances Act; hazardous waste including spent solvents, electronic components and batteries must be manifested and disposed through a DEPC-approved contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate must be issued by the Vanuatu National Fire Service for the production and storage areas; structural load certification for the assembly floor and cleanroom is required from the Vanuatu Public Works Department; occupational hygiene clearance covering electrical safety, ergonomics, cleanroom compliance, emergency egress and respirator-fit testing must be obtained from the Vanuatu Department of Labour before production commences.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Department of Finance and Treasury, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; taxpayer registration and VAT lodgment are administered through the VRC taxpayer services division.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The International Company must first be incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 144] via a VFSC-licensed registered agent, who obtains the IC registration number and certificate of incorporation. For VAT and TIN purposes, the registered agent submits a VRC VAT/TIN registration application together with the certificate of incorporation, certified registered office details, information on directors/shareholders, the entity's Vanuatu business address, and a 12-month forecast of taxable turnover. Non-resident ownership is permitted, no minimum paid-up capital is required, and the TIN is issued once VRC registers the IC as a taxable person.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (Vanuatu International Company: statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty under the International Companies Act; the IC is not subject to entity-level taxation on offshore business activities, although VAT registration obligations apply independently where the IC makes taxable domestic supplies or imports goods into Vanuatu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election mechanism. The International Company's tax-exempt status is automatic and mandatory under the International Companies Act. The only statutory election of practical relevance is voluntary VAT registration under the Value Added Tax Act where annual taxable turnover is below the compulsory threshold.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 annual taxable turnover for goods and VUV 10,000,000 for services under the Value Added Tax Act No. 17 of 1998 (as amended); imported goods are subject to VAT at the border with no threshold exemption for the importer of record.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently impose a mandatory real-time e-invoicing clearance or fiscal digital stamping regime. Taxable suppliers must issue sequentially numbered conventional invoices (paper or electronic) containing the prescribed VAT Act particulars and retain them for VRC audit inspection; export consignments are processed through the VRC Customs electronic declaration and clearance system with automated documentary checks.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to the supply of goods, including ICU mechanical ventilators, where the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within the statutory period stipulated by the Director of Customs (generally 28 days from supply) and the supplier retains the required export evidence. Supplies of services to a non-resident performed wholly outside Vanuatu may also qualify. The zero-rate claim is sustainable only if the exporter holds the full statutory export documentation at the time of filing the VAT return and can demonstrate payment receipt from the foreign buyer.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic declaration accepted by VRC Customs)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Vanuatu
Commercial Invoice quoting the IC TIN and the VAT zero-rating basis
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/FX credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Packing List and Certificate of Origin supporting the exported goods description
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The VRC audits export zero-rating claims by cross-matching the exporter's TIN, customs export entries, shipping manifests, and banking receipts. Where goods are not exported within the statutory period, are reimported into Vanuatu, or the supporting documents are found to be false or materially incomplete, the VAT previously zero-rated is retrospectively clawed back together with default surcharge and interest payable under the Value Added Tax Act. Knowingly submitting fraudulent export declarations constitutes a criminal offence under the VAT Act and the Customs Act, attracting fines and imprisonment, while the VFSC may suspend or strike off the International Company's registration for non-compliance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), constituted under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], which administers the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 26] and licenses authorized foreign-exchange dealers (all Vanuatu-licensed commercial banks).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible on both current and capital account. The Exchange Control Act nominally reserves RBV approval powers, but no prior license or approval is required for equity injections, trade payments, dividends, or capital repatriation by a Vanuatu International Company (IC). Profit remittance is unrestricted once standard AML/EDD and sanctions screening are cleared; no minimum-stay or reinvestment rule applies. ICs are treated as non-residents and may hold multi-currency external accounts (USD, AUD, EUR, XPF, VUV) with licensed dealers. The practical constraint is not convertibility but correspondent-bank de-risking sensitivity, which elevates documentary stringency on all USD cross-border flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender, no mandatory conversion ratio (0%), and no repatriation deadline for medical-device export earnings. Exporters may retain overseas currency or convert freely. The only obligations are record-keeping and reporting of cross-border transactions under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing framework, including suspicious-matter and threshold reports to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit. Proceeds from ICU ventilator exports invoiced in USD or AUD may be held indefinitely in external currency accounts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency USD/VUV/AUD) for IC treasury and SWIFT settlement
Operational and Trade Finance Account (LC advising/confirming, MT103 disbursements)
Operational Account (EUR/XPF/CHF corridor) for European LC counterparties
Capital Escrow Account (VUV domestic settlement only; state-owned lender)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW — not viable as a primary treasury or clearing rail for a Vanuatu International Company. Legal constraints: the International Banking Act 2023 requires any deposit-taking or payment-serving banking business operating in or from Vanuatu to hold an RBV banking license or an international-bank license. Unlicensed offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Dukascopy, and similar neobanks) do not hold Vanuatu licenses; IC use of such an EMI would (i) breach the licensing perimeter if the EMI solicits or receives funds from Vanuatu, (ii) generate name-screening and nested-account red flags for the IC's licensed settlement bank, and (iii) risk immediate de-risking of all Tier-1 Vanuatu bank accounts. The compliant alternative is a licensed-bank multi-currency account with direct SWIFT connectivity; an EMI may be used only as an information overlay in its own licensed jurisdiction and must never touch Vanuatu-sourced funds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical in-branch interview is de facto mandatory for the mandated signatory or a Vanuatu-licensed corporate-services introducer holding a written Power of Attorney. ANZ, BSP, and Bred accept remote document certification (apostilled or certified passports, notarized board resolutions, Tier-1 bank references) but require at least one principal director, UBO, or licensed introducer to attend an in-person KYC session in Port Vila before the account mandate is activated and payment tokens are issued. A fully remote opening is not available for a non-resident-owned IC; a video interview may reduce the process from two trips to one, but final mandate execution requires an in-country physical signature. Practical timeline: 2 to 4 weeks from application to account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company structure with 100% non-resident ownership, nominee shareholders, and no local physical footprint — flags shell, brass-plate, and round-tripping risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified VFSC certificate of incorporation; registered agent confirmation; current register of directors and members with UBO declaration filed under Vanuatu's beneficial-ownership transparency framework; tax-exemption certificate; economic-substance narrative covering manufacturing, trading, and central management decisions; certified passports of UBOs and signatories; and professional reference letters from two Tier-1 banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Government-sector letter-of-credit receivables for ICU ventilators originating from state buyers in higher-risk jurisdictions; dual-use and medical-export-control suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UN/EU/OFAC/UK sanctions screening reports; end-customer and end-use declarations confirming hospital or national health agency destination; purchase contract stating the final facility; OEM quality certifications (CE, ISO 13485, WHO EUL or FDA 510(k)); complete goods trail (commercial invoices, bills of lading, export license or permit where applicable); and a written transaction narrative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound-outbound fund movement without visible goods movement (trade-based money-laundering pattern) involving large advances for ventilator components.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Physical supply-chain evidence package: customs import and export declarations, freight-forwarder documents, inspection and insurance certificates, warehouse receipts; manufacturing capacity substantiation via offtake agreements and production schedules; invoice-to-throughput matching analysis; and signed corporate authorization that all settlements flow exclusively through the IC account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficiary name mismatches or reliance on third-country shell intermediaries in high-risk payment corridors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-transaction counterparty due-diligence file: business-registry extracts for suppliers and distributors; group ownership charts; transaction-flow diagrams showing no hidden intermediaries; sanitized UBO confirmation; and a signed non-circumvention and reliance undertaking executed by the IC.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity for the IC is routed exclusively via SWIFT to a licensed Vanuatu bank. Recommended instruction: MT103 with charge code OUR and purpose code 'Direct investment — subscription of shares in a Vanuatu International Company' (BPM6 direct-investment classification), accompanied by the investor's bank reference and source-of-wealth statement. No RBV exchange-control approval is required; the receiving bank performs transaction monitoring and may file a threshold or suspicious-transaction report with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit where mandated by law. The IC must first submit a board resolution approving the share issue, the updated share register, and a KYC/UBO pack from a licensed introducer. On receipt, funds are credited within T+1 in USD, AUD, or VUV; conversions to the operating currency occur at spot, with an FX-forward overlay for large committed amounts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Vendor payments for ventilator components and logistics settle by SWIFT MT103 for individual disbursements under the bank's trade-finance threshold, with the payment mandate referencing the purchase order and HS code (HS 9018.19; NAICS 339112). Larger evidence-based disbursements use commercial documentary letters of credit (MT700/MT707) issued by the IC's Vanuatu bank in favor of accredited suppliers under UCP 600, and standby LCs (MT760) may be issued to government buyers as performance bonds. Trade settlements into sanctioned or embargoed corridors require express bank compliance clearance; all disbursements must carry the underlying contract number and an unambiguous 'medical ventilators and parts' goods description. For LC receivables, the IC presents a conforming document set (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin, conformity certificates) to the LC issuing or confirming bank; LC discounting and forfaiting may be used to monetize eligible confirmed LC receivables.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore outright FX forwards (maximum 12 months tenor) with licensed authorized dealers (ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Ltd, Bank of South Pacific (Vanuatu) Ltd, Bred Bank (Vanuatu) Ltd) covering committed USD, AUD, and EUR trade receivables and payables.

Vanuatu-regulated cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD or AUD executed under standard ISDA documentation with a licensed commercial bank, with notional amounts matched to confirmed government LC receivables.

Composite LC-discounting-plus-forward structures in which eligible confirmed LC proceeds under UCP 600 are discounted and simultaneously converted at a locked forward rate, eliminating settlement risk on sovereign tender awards.

Trade-related vanilla currency option features embedded in working-capital or trade loans, permissible only for documented underlying exposure and delivered by a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank; exotic or offshore-delivered NDF structures referencing VUV are not available onshore.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for the registration year commencing 1 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Persistent default attracts a late penalty surcharge and may lead to administrative strike-off after 30 days' notice by VFSC

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Confirmation and Registered Office Attestation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with annual return filing, due no later than 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-confirmation renders the company non-compliant and subject to late fees and eventual restoration costs before reactivation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investor Franchise Annual Certification (Medical Device Manufacturing Activity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (IPA) and VFSC as applicable

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain certification may invalidate the foreign investor's license to operate and trigger administrative suspension of the International Company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a Vanuatu International Company unless required by shareholder resolution, lender covenant, or a VFSC directive; entities with licensed regulated activity in financial services may become audit-required
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or acceptable local GAAP for management and consolidated financial statements; no statutory lodging of audited accounts is imposed on an International Company

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain a beneficial ownership record and confirm all shareholding transfers to VFSC annually; any transfer of shares or change of beneficial owner must be reported through the annual confirmation process, with updated registers signed by the directors and kept at the registered office
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Past and Present Registered Agents

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 6,000 per engagement if voluntarily or contractually required

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax on International Companies).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company (IC) regime under International Companies Act [Cap 222]: full statutory exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend/branch withholding tax, stamp duty and estate duties. An IC is subject only to the annual VFSC licence fee (VUV 25,000–250,000 by authorised capital band) and, where a relevant activity exists, the Economic Substance (ESR) registration/notification fee (VUV 25,000). Non-resident ICs with no Vanuatu-source business income pay no VAT (12.5% VAT applies only to taxable supplies made in/imported into Vanuatu).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for a Vanuatu IC. Mandatory annual fiscal filings are: (A) VFSC International Company Annual Licence Renewal (lodged by the registered agent through VFSC e-Services, www.vfsc.vu, or paper covering letter), and (B) ESR Annual Notification/Report (VFSC ESR portal), where the IC carries on a relevant activity.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Licence renewal: on or before the anniversary of incorporation each year (no statutory grace period; VFSC administers a short late-payment window). ESR notification: within 6 months of the IC's financial year-end or as gazetted by the VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IC name as per Instrument of Incorporation, company registration number, date of incorporation, registered office address in Vanuatu, registered agent name.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent holds non-resident beneficial ownership details under AML/CFT CDD; these are not disclosed on the renewal form. Name must match banking and procurement records exactly.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of authorised and issued share capital (USD or VUV) and share classes; determines the annual licence fee band.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may vary capital without Government approval but each variation attracts a VFSC filing fee; under-declaration triggers underpayment penalties.

Capital may be denominated in USD; the registered agent converts and pays VUV to VFSC from the client trust account. Retain the VFSC receipt as proof of good standing for government tenders and bank LC/Swift wiring.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration whether the IC conducts any relevant activity (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing/leasing, headquarters, distribution/service centre, holding entity, IP business) and whether it is a resident or non-resident IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The ICU ventilator manufacturer IC is a non-resident IC if management and control sit outside Vanuatu and it is owned by non-residents. It must file the separate ESR notification and, if the board conducts procurement, risk assumption or IP ownership in Vanuatu, an ESR report showing core income-generating activities in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent certifies the IC is in good standing and authorises payment of the licence fee; VFSC issues the annual receipt.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments are made via Swift wire or Government LC; the certificate of good standing is required for bank account opening and hospital/government procurement participation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal: 10% surcharge on the annual licence fee per month or part-month (capped administratively). Non-payment for 3+ months: VFSC strike-off; assets of the struck-off IC may be forfeited to the Government of Vanuatu (International Companies Act ss. 207–209). Carrying on business after strike-off is an offence: fine up to VUV 500,000; the Court may order directors jointly and severally liable for all debts incurred during the unlawful period.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by an International Company; profits, capital and loan repayments may be repatriated freely to non-resident shareholders with no exchange control restrictions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) network in force and no domestic withholding tax to which a DTA would apply; only TIEAs with certain jurisdictions (e.g., Australia) are in force. Profit repatriation from high-tax markets must therefore rely on foreign domestic law exemptions (participation exemption, manufacturing relief) rather than Vanuatu treaty relief. Where a foreign revenue authority demands proof of Vanuatu residence, the IC obtains (i) a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and (ii) a Tax Residence Certificate from Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRDT), which confirms residence but states the entity is taxed at 0%. The TRC is apostilled/legalised and submitted with the foreign relief claim; foreign GAAR/CFC rules may still deny relief where substance is absent.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu statutory WHT: 0% on outbound and inbound royalties and interest. Foreign inbound WHT (e.g., US 30%, Germany 26.4% corporate, China 10%) is not reduced by any Vanuatu DTA. All intercompany royalty, interest and service fees must therefore be arm's length and supported by economic substance evidence to qualify for foreign domestic exemptions or to avoid treaty-shopping penalties.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in VUV – Vanuatu levies no income tax and has not enacted transfer pricing legislation, so no Local File/Master File statutory thresholds exist. Nevertheless, ESR requires every relevant IC (regardless of revenue) to evidence arm's-length pricing and core income-generating activities (CIGAs) in Vanuatu; recommended documentation is OECD-aligned Master File/Local File plus a CIGA dossier (board minutes, procurement approvals, risk assessment, pricing policy) filed with the ESR report.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu ESR (Economic Substance (Amendment) Act No. 18 of 2019; Economic Substance (Implementation) Regulations 2020) applies to all ICs. A 'non-resident IC' is exempt from tax but must file an ESR notification annually and, where a relevant activity (headquarters, distribution/service centre, holding entity, high-risk IP) is carried on, an ESR report demonstrating: board meetings and decision-making in Vanuatu, adequate employees and premises, and arm's-length active direction. A ventilator manufacturer holding IP, approving contract manufacturers, or assuming product liability in Vanuatu will be treated as conducting a relevant activity; CIGA records must be physically available in Vanuatu. No Vanuatu Business Licence (Cap 246) is required for a non-resident IC with no local physical business presence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abusive Use of Tax-Exempt IC Regime
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as a 'paper passport': all ventilator manufacturing, sales, invoicing and management occur in the market jurisdiction (US/EU/China) while the IC claims Vanuatu 0% tax on real operating profits; under-pricing intercompany sales to strip profits; misrepresenting the foreign PE situation to foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: VFSC strike-off with forfeiture of assets to the Government of Vanuatu; fines up to VUV 1,000,000 for trading while struck off. Foreign jurisdiction: reallocation of profits to a permanent establishment, denial of treaty/tax-exempt benefits, 50–100% civil fraud penalties, criminal tax evasion prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors are jointly and severally liable for struck-off debts; foreign courts may impose worldwide asset freezes, travel bans and extradition; imprisonment up to 15 years where tax evasion proceeds are laundered through Vanuatu accounts (Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap 274]).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance (ESR) Non-Compliance / Shell Company Red Flag
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the ESR notification/report by the statutory deadline; declaring 'no relevant activity' while actually holding ventilator IP, approving procurement, or bearing product risk in Vanuatu; keeping no employees, premises, board minutes or CIGA records in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalties: up to VUV 100,000 per late/failed notification; VUV 500,000 for first confirmed substance failure and up to VUV 1,000,000 per month for continuing contravention; up to VUV 10,000,000 for high-risk IP companies; VFSC may apply to the Court for dissolution and may exchange information with foreign tax authorities under TIEAs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers signing false ESR declarations commit an offence (fine up to VUV 500,000 and/or 12 months' imprisonment); the registered agent will resign on non-compliance, exposing directors to global banking de-risking, public blacklisting as a shell company, and personal civil claims by foreign revenue authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Record-Keeping Failure / Fraudulent Medical Procurement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to keep sufficient accounting records at the registered office in Vanuatu (International Companies Act s. 62); using the IC to receive proceeds of government ventilator tenders while hidden PEPs or sanctioned entities are beneficial owners; layering tender payments through Vanuatu banks without commercial rationale; providing false activity information to VFSC or healthcare regulators.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML/CFT Act No. 35 of 2017: money laundering conviction punishable by fine up to VUV 30,000,000 and/or 15 years' imprisonment for individuals; companies liable to compliance penalties up to VUV 2,000,000; failure to maintain records is a strict-liability offence against the company and each director; VFSC may strike off the IC and notify the Vanuatu FIU. Foreign anti-corruption statutes (FCPA, UKBA) apply to underlying hospital tenders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for civil restitution of illicit tender proceeds; travel bans, freezing orders, enhanced due diligence blacklisting; extradition risk to the market jurisdiction and imprisonment exceeding 15 years for bribery of public hospital officials where proceeds flow through Vanuatu.
